Question 1
?

Which of the following gives the area bounded between the curve defined parametrically as x=tsin⁡t,y=tcos⁡t and the x-axis for t∈[0,π2]?

a
∫0π/2tcos⁡t(sin⁡t−tcos⁡t)dt
b
∫0π/2cos⁡t(cos⁡t+tsin⁡t)dt
c
∫0π/2cos⁡t(sin⁡t+tcos⁡t)dt
d
∫0π/2tcos⁡t(cos⁡t−sin⁡t)dt
e
∫0π/2tcos⁡t(sin⁡t+tcos⁡t)dt
Submit
